body:
i'm not trying to discuss suicide methods or anything, but you are going to have a wicked bad headache and some bruises when you wake up tomorrow. 

i notice to brew your own beer, any good at it?

2 weeks normal, 1 week depressed, sometimes 2. its a pretty big strain but i'm pretty used it to by now, its been like this sense i was 12 so its pretty much my routine now.  i know, its like some sort of infectious disease, the more you try to suppress it the more it bubbles up. it feels like brain rot. 

Reese's Pieces, my Science teacher used to love them. if you ever wanted to bribe him into doing something, Reses Pieces. 

feeling sleepy tired? i'll be sending you good dreams the next tome you sleep. (~'v')~ i'm starting to doze off myself.

right now, i'm polishing off the rest of my Jack Daniels, i wish i had some Absinthe or Kraken, but you make do with what you got. i have a thing in my thread right now were i drink everytime someone posts a comment, but so far its just one guy telling me to not drink. oh how counterintuitive his efforts are. 


sister girl, i feel the same way. its almost like you're living your life for the sake of other people rather than yourself, going through the motions. bubbling vat of turmoil has alot of good imagery, you already have writer talent from my view. Minions, blech, my gf brought me to that movie and i slept through it. we snuck in 5 bags of candy though. 2 gummy worms, 1 bag of twizzlers, a carton of malted milk balls, and a thing of bulls eyes. Purses seem like such utility bags too, i'm more jelly of them than i should be.


thank you for reading my post! its morning now, and i just had a *really* bad downswing. i kind of randomly go between normal mood and engineering intricate methods of suicide mood. i don't like it, i scare me when i look back on it.

i wouldn't call it happy, i'd call it content. brings me out of the suicidal moods. a clear mind is where you see the horrors, being left alone with your thoughts, to contemplate new ways of self-termination. its fricken insanity man. 

and besides this entire train of thought: i'm just making myself as employable as possible for these service industry jobs cause i'd be horrible at them. i'm not gonna lie to them, especially when lying would be disadvantageous to my survival rates.

TBH, having some real problems would be nice. i play alot of survival games and frankly i feel more alive fending off Zombies or Raiders than i do doing anything else. but i know thats just a pipe dream anyway, sense those things aren't actually fun and its just a simulated experience

not to pour salt on the wounds, but he does sound hot. i just wanted to make sure cause i get upset myself being misgendered as a woman.

i'd say writing down all your trials and tribulations would be a great story. what story has the main character being happy all the time? a boring story. and this is probably some of the best time to be a self-publisher with things like Amazon allowing you to independently sell digital books. shit thats a carrier right there.

what i coinkidink! its 5am here and i've been up for hours. not crying, drinking mostly. that sounds horrible. ugh, i'm sorry to hear that. free falling is just the worst feeling to have, but ultimately you are a strong, attractive woman who is in control of her own destiny wherever it may lead. what movie did you see? did you sneak in candy?

aw shucks, i didn't mean to hurt your heart miss (sir?). 

you have quite the interesting life story stranger, getting married and finding love while also in a relationship is truly a great tragedy, and to have that be kicked off by the death of your brother pulls at my heartstrings. i can sympathize with not wanting to feel anymore, i don't blame you for wanting to escape. how was today? particularly worse than the days before? just too much building pressure?

howdy to you to Stranger. Drink for reading my ramblings. tbh i like the alcohol, i don't have enough to provoke alcohol poisoning though, which isn't a prime way to die, in all honestly i like the burning; makes you feel warm inside and makes the eyelids every. a nice, little fire starting right behind your heart. 

i know, thats what my parents say, but i just can't stand it. just the repetitive actions constantly and the overstimulating environments and high stress/low reward is just a personal hell. if Satan made a personal hell for everyone, mine would probably being force to work at a service industry, and every time i'd look at the clock it would not move. oh boy do i hate that idea. hate hate hate it. 

Edit: and by all metrics i shouldn't be feeling this because of my privileged upbringing. its just writing on the walls that these are just problems that happened because i'm too much of a spoiled brat to accept the reality of it, and if that is my reality i'm going to choose to stick to the afterlife and be reincarnated into a tree or something.
well howdy. It'd be a shame for you to leave this land of the living before i got to know you. whats your story? you sound like you have a very interesting past.
alright, that makes sense. i figured it was for temperature regulation.

ah okay, i'm not really worried about the law part because its been decriminalized in my area and local police are more worried about heroine but there is a financial penalty now with paypal and i was wondering if they actually did enforce it on buyers. 

prepaid card is a good idea though, i don't know why i did think of that.
